rationale: Preserve positional read-only pstack plan validation, ordered verifiable units and review gates. Replace fixed ten-lane, model, scheduler and remote assumptions with declared capability evidence and observed capacity. Require checked live receipts and explicit reduced or blocked limits; record justified performance non-applicability separately. Bun fixture checks are structural only. Review gates require explicit interaction applicability and preserve operator media review when applicable. Unavailable workers require reduced-review reason and evidence even for a None. operator gate.
